notes.title: Patch 22nd December 2017
notes.notes:
-Fixed Issues- (minor update)

1.	An issue wherein the game does not launch when the sampling rate is higher than 48000Hz.

2.	An issue wherein the game proceeds with “super speed” when monitors’ refresh rate is 144Hz.

3.	An issue wherein the screen mode cannot be changed back to full screen mode from window mode when players click outside of the primary screen (occurs when users use dual monitors).

4.	An issue wherein certain item information in Collections do not get carried over to the second round of the game.

5.	An issue wherein monsters’ locations in Collections do not get carried over to the second round of the game when players select New Game.
